architectural_reading: GAP proves that the compiler generators act on the 45-point F4-normalizer quotient through a projective/index-2 E6 Weyl half of order 25920. The action is transitive on the 45 quotient points and on the 27 GQ(4,2) lines; its point stabilizer has order 576 and suborbits 1,12,32, while its line stabilizer has order 960. Thus the repo's F4 pocket, GQ(4,2) quotient, and E6 tritangent scale are connected by an explicit GAP-verified projective stabilizer cascade.
boundary: This packet deliberately does not claim the full W(E6) action on the quotient. The GAP action has order 25920, so the missing factor of 2 is an outer-duality/reflection lift that remains the next target.
